data.title: TIDLOR Delivers Strong H1/26 Net Profit Up 26.2%, Driven by Lending & Insurance Brokerage
data.description: Mrs. Athitaya Phoonwathu, Managing Director of Tidlor Holdings Public Company Limited, or Tidlor Holdings (“the Group”) (TIDLOR), revealed that in the second quarter of 2026, the Group continued to deliver strong growth despite the economic slowdown. The Group reported a net profit of 1,533.2 million baht, increasing 18.3% YoY. This resulted in a total net profit of 3,147.0 million baht for the first half of 2026, increasing 26.2% YoY, supported by revenue growth across both the lending and insurance brokerage businesses, coupled with effective cost and asset quality management.

data.title: NEO Wins Prime Minister’s Export Award 2026 for Best Exporter
data.description: Mr. Suthidej Thakolsri, Chief Executive Officer of NEO Corporate Public Company Limited, accepted the Prime Minister’s Export Award 2026 for Best Exporter from Mr. Anutin Charnvirakul, Prime Minister and Minister of Interior. The accolade celebrates NEO’s outstanding success as an innovative Asian FMCG leader committed to enhancing consumers' quality of life. Guided by its "Innovation from Core to Care" philosophy, NEO continues to develop high-quality, accessible Thai brands tailored for daily living, advance manufacturing standards to international levels, and drive sustainable growth across global markets. This recognition further reinforces NEO's strong corporate standing and demonstrates the capability of Thai business leaders to compete sustainably on the world stage. The award presentation was held on August 7, 2026, at the Santi Maitree Building, Government House.

data.title: Thai schools step up security after deadly shooting
data.description: Students stood quietly outside their Bangkok school Friday as teachers checked their bags, pockets and even pencil cases under new security measures introduced after last week's deadly shooting.

data.title: US backs Japan over Putin trip to disputed islands
data.description: TOKYO — The United States recognises Japan's sovereignty over islands visited by Russian President Vladimir Putin, the US ambassador to Tokyo said Friday.

data.title: Reservoir plan gets green light
data.description: <p>The Royal Irrigation Department will press ahead with the Khlong Wang Tanod reservoir in Chanthaburi, citing recent cabinet approval and the need for greater water security.</p>

data.title: Govt pledges to speed up distribution of village funds
data.description: <p>The government will accelerate the distribution of 3.4 billion baht from the National Village and Urban Community Fund to communities yet to receive additional capital.</p>

data.title: Teens arrested for assaulting and robbing Japanese tourist
data.description: Seven youths, between the ages of 13 and 17, were arrested on Thursday night for allegedly robbing and assaulting a Japanese tourist, who was lost near Makkasan Airport Rail Link station. The suspects told police they attacked the tourist with their fists to rob 1,400 baht.

data.title: QR case hearing on Aug 26
data.description: <p>The Constitutional Court has scheduled a witness hearing for Aug 26 in a case concerning the use of barcodes and QR codes on ballot papers in the Feb 8 general election.</p>

data.title: DLA opens score review for local govt candidates
data.description: <p>Candidates in the 2025 local government recruitment examination can review their scores from now until the end of the month, acting Department of Local Administration (DLA) director-general Nirat Pongsitthaworn said yesterday.</p>

data.title: Firms to design two new routes
data.description: <p>The State Railway of Thailand (SRT) board has approved consultancy contracts worth a combined 392.8 million baht to design two new railway projects linking the North and Northeast, with the contracts expected to be signed in September.</p>

data.title: Govt to host 29th ALMM
data.description: <p>Thailand will host the 29th Asean Labour Ministers Meeting (ALMM) from Aug 23-28 at the Dusit Thani Bangkok, focusing on internationally recognised skills certification to prepare the region's workforce for the digital and green economies and an ageing society.</p>

data.title: Dept warns of fake Lampang bowls
data.description: <p>The Department of Intellectual Property has warned consumers about widely sold fake Rooster-brand ceramic bowls native to Lampang in the northern region, citing the product's geographical indication (GI) protection.</p>

data.title: BKKIFF 2026 aims to bring Thailand’s film industry to the global stage
data.description: BKKIFF 2026 will screen more than 150 films and host industry activities across Bangkok from Sunday (September 13, 2026) to Sunday (September 27, 2026).

data.title: How close can music get?
data.description: What does a livehouse actually need to be? A tiny room? A sticky floor? A band playing three metres away from your face? Someone yelling into a microphone while a hundred people lose their minds?

data.title: US, Mexico conduct security exercises near border
data.description: CIUDAD JUáREZ (MEXICO) - US and Mexican armed forces performed exercises on Thursday along the border near the cities of El Paso and Ciudad Juarez.

data.title: Thousands stranded at Japan's Narita airport after record rain kills four
data.description: TOKYO — Record rainfall left thousands of travellers stranded at Tokyo's Narita airport on Friday as flooding in the surrounding area disrupted transport, knocked out power ​to homes and ⁠claimed at least four lives.

data.title: 'I want to be Eala': Philippine sensation sparks tennis boom at home
data.description: MANILA - On a Manila court made of crushed seashells, an earnest four-year-old sends a forehand sailing wide –- one of dozens of kids aiming to follow in the footsteps of the Philippines' first homegrown tennis sensation, Alexandra Eala.

data.title: Army receives 2,900 dengue vaccine doses for troops
data.description: The Medical Association of Thailand has donated 2,900 dengue vaccine doses for Army personnel serving in areas at high risk of outbreaks

data.title: These  dinos soar
data.description: <p>The original Jurassic Park (1993) set such a high bar for every dinosaur movie franchise that followed, even fans of dinosaur films admit that the modern sequels have never quite been able to replicate the magic of Spielberg's original masterpiece.</p>
